visual_review.result: The five content sections, footer, and final native switch are visible and readable. Real scrolling exposes the final switch; its observed state changes amber to green and back to amber.

evidence_limitations: Native app-texture readback lagged the preceding interaction despite capture timestamp changes: the bottom capture still showed the top, and the on-state capture still showed the previous off state. These images are retained as diagnostics and are not used to prove post-scroll or toggle state.
The measured approximately 80-pixel vertical origin is the Android status-bar inset. It does not establish a nonzero nested host-pane origin beyond OS insets.
The native toggle demonstrates ephemeral widget interaction only, not an L0 business reducer, backend write, or persisted toggle state.
evidence_basis: Actual OS screenshots and pixel analysis; supplemental native captures lag interactions.
